period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account, read from National Bank's own Q1-2019 unaudited financial statements (clean digital text, but with a badly corrupted underlying text layer in numeric cells throughout the Balance Sheet -- much worse than most other quarters in this series). Comparative column (31 Dec 2018) is legible on the highest-confidence lines (equity 44,809,353,067; total_deposits 315,206,033,967 [component sums]; gross_loans 314,507,263,171; nav_per_share 16.88) and reproduces this dataset's existing FY2018 figures exactly, confirming correct Solo section. The P&L is fully clean and internally consistent (Total Operating Income - Total Operating Expenses = Profit Before Provision = printed exactly; - Provision = Profit Before Tax = printed exactly; - Tax = PAT = printed exactly), and every P&L line item was independently cross-validated against 2020_Q1.json's own comparative column (Jan-Mar 2019), which reproduces net_interest_income, investment_income, commission, other operating income, operating expenses, profit-before-provision, profit-before-tax and PAT all EXACTLY. Balance-sheet totals were less fortunate: TOTAL ASSETS and TOTAL LIABILITIES are not legibly printed for the current (Mar-2019) column at all (near-total OCR/text-layer noise), so both were derived via the identity Total Liabilities = Borrowings (4,682,332,794, as printed in this Solo panel -- NOTE: the Consolidated panel of the same filing shows a different Borrowings figure of 8,642,332,794, which is plausible as a genuine Solo-vs-Consolidated difference given a subsidiary's own borrowing, not treated as an error) + Total Deposits (319,134,539,599) + Subordinated Bond (4,000,000,000) + Other Liabilities (36,703,642,367) = 364,520,514,760; Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Equity (45,294,035,957) = 409,814,550,717. investments_securities could not be read directly (the Government/Others investment sub-lines are almost completely unrecoverable) and was derived as a residual plug (Total Assets minus all other legible/estimated asset line items, including an estimated ~4,230m for 'balance with other banks' interpolated from the Solo-vs-Consolidated gap seen in neighbouring quarters) -- this plug (45,189.44m) carries meaningfully higher uncertainty than every other figure in this record and should be treated with caution; it happens to sit close to the Dec-2018 Government-only sub-line (45,182.48m), which may or may not be coincidental. EPS was not legibly printed for the Solo panel (only the Consolidated panel's label survives, with no value); it is calculated as PAT / shares outstanding (paid-up capital 26,549,079,130 unchanged from Dec-2018, / Taka 10 face value = 2,654,907,913 shares) = 0.18. interest_income and interest_expense are not legible anywhere in this document (both columns of that specific P&L row are corrupted) and could not be recovered via identity (net_interest_income alone is insufficient to split into its two components), so both are marked unavailable.
